patch_list: The "watch a video" buttons give you the reward straight away. Tap one and the rings, red star rings, gems or unlock are yours — no video and no waiting.
Everything sold for real money is free. Tap a ring pack, a gem pack, a red star ring bundle or a character offer and it is granted straight away — no payment screen and no charge.
Stops banners, full-screen interstitials and ad pop-ups from appearing. Runs and menus carry on as normal — the ads just never show up.
